t2.thesis: Strong fundamental momentum, a consistent record of positive earnings-open reactions and beats offset a large priced-in move and a run-up into the print, leaving a slight edge over the base rate.
reasons: Last 4 prints: 3 of 4 positive on the open, with consistent EPS beats of 7-32%
Revenue growth of ~27%, 30% operating margin and raised FCF guidance point to a business that keeps beating
Implied move of ~14% is large relative to 60d realized vol, so the premium is rich and the edge is small
Stock rallied about 16% over the last month into the print, which raises the bar
Short interest of ~19% of float and rising EPS estimates (+6.5% over 90 days) cut both ways
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 bookings growth and Q4 guidance relative to the roughly 20% bookings growth already guided, plus the FCF outlook.

prior.from: I3 BMO session base rate 0.548 and software_internet cluster 0.541; overall ~0.54

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up about +0.01 from the 0.55 prior on the beat history and positive revisions, then held back by the run-up and the rich implied move.

theses.expected: Rise: bookings and revenue beat, FCF guide raised again, short covering
theses.mechanism: High short interest and a history of beats lead to a sharp gap up on the open
theses.wrong_if: Bookings growth decelerates below the guided ~20% or Active CLEAR+ member growth stalls

theses.expected: Fall: sell-the-news after the 16% one-month run-up
theses.mechanism: Expectations are elevated, so an in-line print and cautious Q4 guidance trigger profit-taking
theses.wrong_if: The stock gaps up despite in-line numbers

theses.expected: Flat to modest move: the stock moves less than the options imply
theses.mechanism: Implied vol is 2.35x realized vol, so a muted reaction leaves the sign close to random
theses.wrong_if: The open moves more than 10% in either direction

key_observations: Total Bookings growth versus the ~20.5% guide
Active CLEAR+ member growth and retention
Q4 and full-year guidance, and the FCF raise
Management transition commentary after the President's departure
